item.title: Iran war’s oil shock fuels GOP political anxiety
item.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Tuesday would be “our most intense day of strikes,” after President Trump sent conflicting messages about the administration’s plans.

item.title: U.S. orders more diplomats to leave Middle East
item.summary: The State Department’s most recent directives apply to personnel in Turkey and Saudi Arabia, underscoring the ongoing threat posed by Iranian counterattacks.

item.title: Australia grants asylum to 5 Iranian soccer players after Trump pressure
item.summary: The late-night visa approval came after a days-long operation, authorities said. The players had been criticized back home after they stood silently during the Iranian anthem.

item.title: Consumer advocates, Democrats denounce Live Nation deal as inadequate
item.summary: Officials have alleged that Ticketmaster and parent company Live Nation Entertainment held an illegal monopoly over concerts and other live events.

item.title: Trump’s pick advances in race to replace Marjorie Taylor Greene
item.summary: Clay Fuller, a district attorney, led among Republicans to replace the former congresswoman in deep-red Georgia, while Rep. Bennie Thompson (D-Mississippi) fended off a primary challenge.

item.title: Why Congress keeps handing Trump its power
item.summary: Trump’s second presidency has accelerated the growth of executive power at the expense of the legislative branch, raising concerns about the balance of powers.

item.title: Senators seek review of Justice Department’s handling of Epstein files
item.summary: A bipartisan group of senators raised concerns in a letter to the Government Accountability Office that the department failed to redact names and photos of victims.

item.title: Democrats ask what happened to millions earmarked for Trump’s library
item.summary: ABC, Meta, Paramount and X reportedly agreed to pay at least $63 million in settlements with the president. The original fund was dissolved last year.

item.title: RFK Jr.’s vaccine advisers drop proposal to revisit covid-19 shot
item.summary: Some members of the CDC’s vaccine advisory panel have publicly questioned the safety and manufacturing of the shots, including raising a debunked theory that DNA contaminants in the vaccines are harmful.

item.title: ‘Titanic’ statue of Trump and Epstein on the Mall draws praise, scorn
item.summary: The statue, depicting them embracing on a copy of the Titanic bow, is the third placed on the Mall by the artists depicting a connection between Trump and Epstein.
